values.binNote: Wiki states the quick-release threshold as 0.4s, but the bin's PykeQ.MinChargeTime is 0.5. The two sources disagree; the wiki's value is recorded here as it is the more current live-description, while the bin row may be stale relative to the current game version.

values.quote: '''Pyke''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% for up to 3 seconds

mechanics.claim: The recast (empowered harpoon) deals damage to the first enemy hit and pulls them; if released within 0.4s it instead thrusts and hits the closest enemy champion, or closest enemy otherwise, for the same damage.
mechanics.quote: dealing the same damage to the closest enemy {{tip|champion}}, or closest enemy otherwise

mechanics.claim: Pyke becomes unable to act while the empowered harpoon is in flight, and the lockout ends when it hits, reaches max range, or is intercepted.
mechanics.quote: becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} while it is in flight

mechanics.claim: The ability's mana cost is refunded if the recast hits an enemy champion.
mechanics.quote: ''Bone Skewer's'' {{as|mana cost}} is also refunded if it hits an enemy champion

mechanics.claim: If the charge is interrupted or completes without a recast, the ability is cancelled and put on full cooldown, refunding 75% of the mana cost.
mechanics.quote: the ability is put on {{sti|cd|full}} cooldown but refunds {{sti|mana|{{as|75% of the mana cost}}}}

mechanics.claim: Cooldown begins after the recast/post-effect, not on initial cast.
